summary: The RptMnuPositionUtilizationSummary control is used to generate reports on position utilization. It allows users to specify start and end dates, select agency, department, and program, and provides validation for input fields. Reports can be generated in CSV format.
purpose: To provide a user interface for generating position utilization summary reports.

workflows.name: Generate Position Utilization Summary Report
steps: User specifies start and end dates
Click cmdRunExcel to generate CSV report

business_rules: The report is generated based on selected parameters: agency, department, program, and date range.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end dates
conditions: UserSession must be active for generating reports
